SEM_INT_001: SELECT m.client_name, r.batch_id, r.status, r.batch_cost FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id ORDER BY m.client_id,r.batch_id;
SEM_INT_002: SELECT c.product_name, COUNT(r.batch_id) AS record_count FROM chip_products c LEFT JOIN production_batches r ON c.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY c.product_id,c.product_name ORDER BY c.product_id;
SEM_INT_003: SELECT r.batch_id FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id WHERE e.test_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_INT_004: SELECT r.batch_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) AS total_amount FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_INT_005: SELECT r.batch_id, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM production_batches r JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id HAVING SUM(e.amount)>20000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
SEM_INT_006: SELECT m.segment, COUNT(r.batch_id) AS record_count FROM clients m LEFT JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id GROUP BY m.segment ORDER BY m.segment;
SEM_INT_007: SELECT c.category, AVG(r.batch_cost) AS average_amount FROM chip_products c JOIN production_batches r ON c.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
SEM_INT_008: SELECT m.client_name, r.batch_id, c.product_name, r.status FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id JOIN chip_products c ON r.product_id=c.product_id ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_INT_009: SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name,SUM(r.batch_cost) AS total_amount FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id GROUP BY m.client_id,m.client_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
SEM_INT_010: SELECT batch_id,batch_cost FROM production_batches WHERE batch_cost>(SELECT AVG(batch_cost) FROM production_batches) ORDER BY batch_cost DESC;
SEM_INT_011: SELECT e.test_id,e.test_date,e.test_type,e.amount,r.status AS record_status FROM test_results e JOIN production_batches r ON e.batch_id=r.batch_id ORDER BY e.test_id;
SEM_INT_012: SELECT r.batch_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_INT_013: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',test_date)::date AS event_month,COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM test_results GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',test_date) ORDER BY event_month;
SEM_INT_014: SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name FROM clients m LEFT JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id WHERE r.batch_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.client_id;
SEM_INT_015: SELECT c.product_id,c.product_name FROM chip_products c LEFT JOIN production_batches r ON c.product_id=r.product_id WHERE r.batch_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.product_id;
SEM_INT_016: SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name,MIN(r.production_date) AS first_date FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id GROUP BY m.client_id,m.client_name ORDER BY m.client_id;
SEM_INT_017: SELECT r.batch_id,MAX(e.test_date) AS latest_event_date FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_INT_018: SELECT DISTINCT m.client_id,m.client_name FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id WHERE e.status='Completed' ORDER BY m.client_id;
SEM_INT_019: SELECT c.category,AVG(e.amount) AS average_event_amount FROM chip_products c JOIN production_batches r ON c.product_id=r.product_id JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
SEM_INT_020: SELECT m.segment,r.status,COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id GROUP BY m.segment,r.status ORDER BY m.segment,r.status;
SEM_EXP_001: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name,SUM(e.amount) total_amount FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY m.client_id,m.client_name) SELECT client_id,client_name,total_amount,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM totals ORDER BY amount_rank,client_id;
SEM_EXP_002: SELECT r.batch_id,MAX(e.test_date) AS latest_event_date FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id HAVING MAX(e.test_date)<DATE '2026-01-01' OR MAX(e.test_date) IS NULL ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_EXP_003: WITH totals AS (SELECT client_id,SUM(batch_cost) total_amount FROM production_batches GROUP BY client_id) SELECT client_id,total_amount FROM totals WHERE total_amount>(SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM totals) ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
SEM_EXP_004: SELECT batch_id,batch_cost,CASE WHEN batch_cost>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN batch_cost>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM production_batches ORDER BY batch_id;
SEM_EXP_005: WITH monthly AS (SELECT batch_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',test_date)::date event_month,SUM(amount) monthly_amount FROM test_results GROUP BY batch_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',test_date)) SELECT batch_id,event_month,monthly_amount,LAG(monthly_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id ORDER BY event_month) previous_month_amount FROM monthly ORDER BY batch_id,event_month;
SEM_EXP_006: SELECT batch_id,test_id,test_date,amount,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id ORDER BY test_date,test_id) running_amount FROM test_results ORDER BY batch_id,test_date,test_id;
SEM_EXP_007: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id ORDER BY amount DESC,test_id) rn FROM test_results e) SELECT test_id,batch_id,amount FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY batch_id,rn;
SEM_EXP_008: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.batch_id,COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) total_amount FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id) SELECT batch_id,total_amount,ROUND(100.0*total_amount/NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER(),0),2) percent_of_total FROM totals ORDER BY batch_id;
SEM_EXP_009: SELECT client_id,batch_id,batch_cost,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY batch_cost DESC) amount_rank FROM production_batches ORDER BY client_id,amount_rank,batch_id;
SEM_EXP_010: SELECT batch_id,test_id,test_date,amount,LAG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id ORDER BY test_date,test_id) previous_amount FROM test_results ORDER BY batch_id,test_date,test_id;
SEM_EXP_011: SELECT batch_id,test_id,test_date,amount,AVG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id ORDER BY test_date,test_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) moving_average FROM test_results ORDER BY batch_id,test_date,test_id;
SEM_EXP_012: SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name FROM clients m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM production_batches r WHERE r.client_id=m.client_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM production_batches r WHERE r.client_id=m.client_id AND r.status<>'Active') ORDER BY m.client_id;
SEM_EXP_013: SELECT batch_id,status,batch_cost FROM production_batches r WHERE batch_cost>(SELECT AVG(x.batch_cost) FROM production_batches x WHERE x.status=r.status) ORDER BY status,batch_cost DESC;
SEM_EXP_014: SELECT r.batch_id,MIN(e.test_date) first_event,MAX(e.test_date) last_event,MAX(e.test_date)-MIN(e.test_date) active_days FROM production_batches r JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_EXP_015: SELECT test_id,batch_id,amount,ROUND(100.0*amount/NULLIF(SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id),0),2) record_percent FROM test_results ORDER BY batch_id,test_id;
SEM_EXP_016: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name,m.segment,SUM(r.batch_cost) total_amount FROM clients m JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id GROUP BY m.client_id,m.client_name,m.segment), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amount DESC,client_id) rn FROM totals) SELECT client_id,client_name,segment,total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY segment;
SEM_EXP_017: SELECT test_id,batch_id,amount FROM test_results e WHERE amount>(SELECT AVG(x.amount) FROM test_results x WHERE x.batch_id=e.batch_id) ORDER BY batch_id,amount DESC;
SEM_EXP_018: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.client_id,m.client_name,COUNT(r.batch_id) record_count FROM clients m LEFT JOIN production_batches r ON m.client_id=r.client_id GROUP BY m.client_id,m.client_name) SELECT client_id,client_name,record_count FROM counts WHERE record_count>(SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts) ORDER BY record_count DESC,client_id;
SEM_EXP_019: SELECT r.batch_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Pending' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) pending_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) failed_amount FROM production_batches r LEFT JOIN test_results e ON r.batch_id=e.batch_id GROUP BY r.batch_id ORDER BY r.batch_id;
SEM_EXP_020: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY batch_id ORDER BY test_date DESC,test_id DESC) rn FROM test_results e) SELECT test_id,batch_id,test_date,test_type,amount,status FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY batch_id;
